environment: Local production build, synthetic review account and Matrix room
transport: Chrome CDP Network.requestWillBeSent; reaction procedure only; no request bodies or credentials retained
functionalChecks: Added a thumbs-up to a synthetic group message through the production UI
Reloaded and confirmed the saved reaction remained visible
Opened the same message in a thread at a 390 by 844 viewport
Confirmed the shared reaction and preserved bottom navigation
Removed only the reaction created for this test from the thread
Returned to the room and confirmed the reaction was removed
limitations: Single local browser and synthetic room; not a load or capacity qualification
Background, offline, unmount and delayed responses are covered by automated hook and real HTTP transport tests, not this visual measurement
Visibility gating covers group details, participant profiles, room search and the room timeline hidden by a narrow thread; global settings overlays are not included
Message history still requires incremental sync qualification
